subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Utilizar diferentes linguagens, mídias e ferramentas digitais em processos de produção coletiva, colaborativa e projetos autorais em ambientes digitais.

components.description_pt: Colaborar com colegas, usando ferramentas digitais, para contribuir a um produto de escrita compartilhado
components.description_en: Collaborate with peers, using digital tools, to contribute to a shared writing product
components.cc_component_description: Collaborate with peers, using digital tools, to contribute to a shared writing product

components.description_pt: Aplicar ferramentas digitais para desenvolver projetos autorais originais em ambientes digitais
components.description_en: Apply digital tools to develop original authorial projects in digital environments
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and publish written products for an intended audience

components.description_pt: Avaliar o papel de cada linguagem ou meio escolhido em um processo de produção digital colaborativa
components.description_en: Evaluate the role of each language or medium chosen in a collaborative digital production process
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the advantages of a specific medium for conveying a particular topic or idea

cc_matches.description: With guidance and support from adults, use a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers.

Use technology, including the Internet, to produce, publish, and update individual or shared writing products, taking advantage of technology's capacity to link to other information and to display information flexibly and dynamically.
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of using different mediums (e.g., print or digital text, video, multimedia) to present a particular topic or idea.
